notes: Shelf rebuilt from 4 old kinds (k6–k9, 48 model rows) to 6 kinds. New kinds: Kit & prefab house (s Wikipedia Prefabricated home; archetypes Sears Modern Home, Lustron house, Huf Haus) and Manufactured home (s Wikipedia Manufactured housing; single/double/triple-wide as types). Static caravan: 21 SKUs cut to one range line per maker (Willerby, ABI, Swift, Atlas, Carnaby, Pemberton, Victory) from maker pages; widths and spec levels moved to types. Park home: 4 Willerby SKUs become one lodge range plus Willerby park homes, Omar, Pemberton, Victory, Swift, Atlas and Prestige ranges. Park model: 7 Athens Park SKUs dropped, 9 ranges from 5 makers kept from old data (old s kept; RVIA definition page was not accessible so the ~400 sq ft figure rests on the Athens Park page). Tiny house on wheels: Tumbleweed becomes the originating archetype with Mobile Hermitage (2003) and the four old models as versions; Minimaliste and Tiny House Building Company trimmed to ranges. Left out: Boxabl, Escape, Tiny Heirloom, Kropf/Elevation/Canterbury brand pages, Skyline Homes as a separate brand (folded into Champion Homes) and UK post-war 'prefabs' — no page retrieved this session (search budget exhausted). Prestige and Tiny House Building Company appear only as range makers without register entries. Carried-over kinds keep their old s URLs. Huf ART/MODUM version years not stated on the retrieved pages, left blank. The wiki tool failed with a lock error mid-session; all later Wikipedia pages were retrieved via web_fetch.
